<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def frame_obj():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and 40<=n['pixels']<=120 and 20<=n['boundary'][0][0]<33:
            return (n['color'],n['pixels'],[tuple(p) for p in n['boundary']])
    return None
print('before', frame_obj())
action(['RIGHT'])
print('after RIGHT', frame_obj())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
